text: 金十数据10月17日讯，10月16日，证监会发布行政处罚决定书显示，3名自然人因操纵市场及内幕交易被罚。其中，周吉锋、周吉辉操纵证券市场共计被罚没约3.28亿元，对周吉锋采取5年证券市场禁入措施，对周吉锋采取3年证券市场禁止交易措施。陈秋航因内幕交易被罚没近1.82亿元。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 17: On October 16, the CSRC issued an administrative penalty decision showing that three individuals were penalized for market manipulation and insider trading. Among them, Zhou Jifeng and Zhou Jihui were collectively fined and had illegal gains confiscated totaling about RMB 328 million for manipulating the securities market; Zhou Jifeng was banned from the securities market for 5 years, and Zhou Jifeng was prohibited from trading in the securities market for 3 years. Chen Qiuhang was fined and had illegal gains confiscated totaling nearly RMB 182 million for insider trading.
